classification_rationale: This is a standard end-of-rental question about whether collection will be arranged or the item dropped off, which is ordinary return logistics.

draft.reply_body:
Dear Timo,

Thanks for letting us know you're finishing up with the compact track loader. We're happy to arrange collection from your site, or if it's easier you're welcome to drop it back at the depot - just let us know which you'd prefer and we'll get it booked in.

As a reminder, the deposit is returned within five working days of the equipment being checked in, provided it comes back undamaged and complete.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
